description: Shared Renovate rules for every Huishouden repo. Each repo's renovate.json extends this.

packageRules.description: The shared kit: update as soon as it releases and merge when CI is green.
Everything else that isn't a major version: one weekly PR, merged when CI is green, only with releases at least a week old (a hijacked package is usually caught and pulled within days).
Major versions can break things: wait for approval on the dependency dashboard.
